# PhysicsPose

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/physics/physics_sys.h`](../../../src/physics/physics_sys.h) · Scene / prefab name: `null` · Described in `data/core.json`

The last two simulated poses of a dynamic body

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `prev_position` | `glm::vec3` | pose before the last step |
| `position` | `glm::vec3` | pose after the last step |
| `prev_rotation` | `glm::quat` |  |
| `rotation` | `glm::quat` |  |

## Notes

Put on dynamic bodies by RigidBody; updated by Physics (host, which interpolates the Transform between them) and PhysicsStep (worlds; WorldView interpolates).

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AnimalSync](../systems/AnimalSync.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[BodySync](../systems/BodySync.md)**
  - Adds PhysicsPose to the drawn shape entities.
- **[DesktopRoller](../systems/DesktopRoller.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[Physics](../systems/Physics.md)**
  - Steps the host's Jolt PhysicsSystem on its job system threads.
  - Destroys entities whose interpolated position is under -1000 m.
  - Runs the FixedSteps functions of other systems inside its tick.
  - Profiler zones Physics step, Fixed steps before, Jolt update, Fixed steps after; plots Physics steps, Active bodies.
- **[PhysicsStep](../systems/PhysicsStep.md)**
  - Steps the world's Jolt PhysicsSystem (single threaded with threads 1).
- **[RigidBody](../systems/RigidBody.md)**
  - Creates, adds, removes and destroys Jolt bodies; OptimizeBroadPhase after static geometry is added.
  - Connects on_destroy<RigidBody>, on_destroy<Ground>, on_destroy<HeightField> (disconnected in finish and the destructor).
  - Log warnings on invalid shapes, invalid height fields and when Jolt is out of bodies.
- **[SandboxLife](../systems/SandboxLife.md)**
  - Drains the contact listener's recorded events (the listener is SandboxSys's).
- **[SphereControl](../systems/SphereControl.md)**
  - Adds a torque to the sphere's Jolt body every tick the held torque is not zero.
  - At a reset teleports the Jolt body and builds the marching cubes colliders around the spawn point synchronously.
  - Logs an error in init when the world does not hold exactly one SphereAgent + Transform + RigidBody entity.
- **[SphereObserve](../systems/SphereObserve.md)**
  - Three downward ray casts against the world's static bodies per window.
  - At a trainer RESET, teleports the Jolt body and builds the spawn column's colliders.
- **[SphereView](../systems/SphereView.md)**
  - ImGui window "Sphere roller"; collapses "Dynamical", "Worlds" and "Frame time" on first use.
  - Five host entities for the markers, destroyed in finish.
- **[VRBody](../systems/VRBody.md)**
  - Teleports the player's Jolt body by the head's motion each frame (`BodyInterface::SetPosition`, activated).
- **[VRHands](../systems/VRHands.md)**
  - At each physics step: `SetPositionAndRotation` + `SetLinearAndAngularVelocity` of a hand more than `failsafe` from its target; `AddForce` of its share (by mass) of the legs' force.
  - Sets the collision group of each hand body once.
- **[VRRoller](../systems/VRRoller.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[WorldView](../systems/WorldView.md)**
  - Uploads generated capsule meshes to the GPU through ModelManager::add (Transfer), once per size.
  - Creates and destroys host entities as bodies appear and go; destroys all of them in finish.
